parent.construct: AtHOL1 (Q0WP12) residues 1-226 plus C-terminal LEHHHHHH His6 tag (235 aa SEQRES); crystallographic chain A, observed residues 13-228; monomer biological assembly; X-ray 1.8 A
parent.source: Schmidberger et al. 2010, PMID 20376845, DOI 10.1002/anie.201000119; RCSB 3LCC

cosubstrate.name: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine (SAH)
cosubstrate.source: PubChem CID 439155; also HET SAH 3LCC chain A residue 300

non_native_substrate.name: ethyl iodide
non_native_substrate.distinct_from: methyl iodide (CI) — native-like donor; ethyl iodide is the target non-native donor

reactants.reaction: SAH + ethyl iodide -> ethyl-SAH sulfonium (SAE) + iodide; SN2 alkylation of SAH sulfur by ethyl iodide, analog of the reverse HMT SAM-synthesis reaction.
reactants.reaction_state_model: REACTANT complex: protein + SAH + ethyl iodide (no modeled TS, no iodide离开 group placement assumed). 3LCC SAH product complex used for pocket geometry; surface chloride CL301 at 22.7 A from SAH SD is NOT the catalytic halide and is excluded from the reactive model.

chemistry_caveat: The native HMT direction is halide + SAM -> CH3X + SAH. The requested ethylation of SAH by ethyl iodide is the reverse; SAH+EtI reactant complex is a chemically consistent Michaelis-like model, but no transition state or electric-field calculation is available in the catalog. Predicted kinetics from CatPred are ML estimates with unknown units/applicability to AtHOL1+EtI; never presented as measured activity or a barrier.

edit_mask.derivation: Protected = SAH/cosubstrate-contact residues within 9 A of SAH SD in 3LCC, nucleophile-channel residues D186/V187/S188 and S189 from the Schmidberger 2010 W35/W68/W198 channel, conserved cysteines/glycines in the SAH binding region, and the C-terminal His6 tag. NO published winner or prior-engineering residue list was used (see private/UNINTENDED_EXPOSURE.md).

budgets.policy: No added cap; preserve cumulative accounting including all specialist calls.

primary_endpoint.unit: as returned by Cat_Pred output (not documented in contract; read actual values)
primary_endpoint.min_improvement_rationale: Any positive signed kcat change counts as numerical improvement; not a significance test. Eligibility is gated by separate stability/quality/geometry evidence.
primary_endpoint.not: not measured activity, not reaction barrier, not electric field, not docking score

screening.shortlist_rule_declared: Retain variants with (a) all protected positions unchanged, (b) <=8 substitutions, (c) no high-risk stability/solubility flag relative to parent (Thermal_MPNN sum of ddG >= -5 kcal/mol and Netsolp solubility not worse than parent by >1 unit, if outputs available); rank retained by CatPred predicted kcat; take top 3-4 for structure assessment. Rule frozen before observing outputs.
screening.catalytic_acceptance_ranges: UNAVAILABLE for AtHOL1+ethyl iodide; use Catalytic_Geometry measurement_only (descriptive distances/angles only). No invented permissive bounds; no activity pass/fail from geometry.

final_evaluator_protocol.common_csv: Seq_id,Sequences,SMILES with SMILES=CCI for all rows

unavailable: SubTuner electric-field / electronic-structure reaction endpoint not in catalog; remains explicitly unresolved. No advanced DFT/MD substitute after results.
